gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-duru-sans: Capture It towers, its letters nearly sealed shut and drawn without any thick-thin flicker. Duru Sans opens right up beneath it, a plain sans whose wide small letters crowd the line while ascenders barely show, so shrinking the heading would waste that tension.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-fresca: Fresca keeps its counters connected to the outside, with short ascenders sitting above big, generous bowls and no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Capture It is the tight, urban opposite, its letters nearly sealed.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-funnel-sans: Commanding and urban, Capture It stands tall on its towering x-height. Funnel Sans is the sans-serif below, its lowercase e pried open like a clasp, and body text could stay modest while the heading carries the volume.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-gafata: Capture It draws every letter in one uninterrupted line, towering and urban. Gafata sits below as a plain sans with a tall band of letters, short stalks above and wide-eyed e shapes, so a size jump between the two would feel natural.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-geist: Geist reads quiet and level, with no accents of weight breaking the beat. Over a longer passage its words settle into solid blocks rather than skylines, a sturdy foil to the tightly shut, commanding letters of Capture It.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-georama: Capture It leads with an urban, commanding towering x-height and letters that feel nearly sealed, while Georama, a sans-serif with a bracelet-wide c, sits below it. The tension between shut and open is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-gidole: Capture It towers with a tall x-height and no thick-thin flicker, its openings so slight the letters feel nearly sealed. Gidole answers with scissor-blade terminals and neon-tube strokes, a plain sans that would read smoothly for pages.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-golos-text: Capture It stacks a towering x-height with letters that feel nearly sealed, all of it urban and commanding. Golos Text opens a widely parted s beneath, so the sans feels friendly beside it.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-hedvig-letters-: Capture It draws a plain, unshaded line that never swells, giving it an urban, commanding stance. And Hedvig Letters Sans, a sans with a clear gap where the c ends, is approachable, so the heading earns its keep when big and short.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-heebo: Heebo holds a tall central band of text. Its curves stop short instead of closing in, so a longer passage stays easy going, a plain sans set against the sealed, towering look of Capture It.
